appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint: Applies to every workspace and is saved in your personal settings.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Messages from databases and SSH servers are shown as they arrive.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.showSystemHint: System schemas (pg_catalog, information_schema, sys…) and the roles, users and logins built into each engine.
explorer.sortingHint: Without alphabetical order, names keep the order the database returns. Columns always keep their table's order. Folders first puts roles, users and the like before the schemas.
explorer.serverSideFiltersHint: A connection's filters go into the database's catalog queries, so a server with thousands of schemas or tables only sends what passes them. Turned off, every name is read and filtered on this computer; what you see is the same.

history.title: History
history.stored: Every query you run from the app is saved on this computer with its connection, time, duration, row count and error. Opening a saved query never runs it.
history.perConnection: Saving is set per connection: open the “⋯” menu next to a connection in the sidebar. Turn it off before running SQL with passwords or other secrets. Turning it off keeps the queries already saved.
history.audit: This history belongs to the desktop app. Queries from AI agents (spelaiondb mcp) go to a separate audit log.

network.title: Network
network.profilesIntro: A network profile is how connections reach their databases: SSH hops, a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, or both. Many connections can share one; changing it changes all of them. Connections choose theirs in their SSH tab.
network.portsIntro: SSH tunnels listen on a local port of this computer (127.0.0.1). By default any free one is used.
network.saved: Saved. Tunnels opened from now on use it.
network.portsHint: Useful when a firewall or another tool only allows some ports. A connection with its own local port (in its SSH tab) keeps that one.

updates.title: Updates
updates.unavailable: Automatic updates are not available in this build yet. New versions are on the releases page.
updates.atStartup: Check for updates when the app starts
updates.hint: Updates are signed and installed only when you click “Install and restart”. Open tabs come back with their SQL, not run.
